main_result: If P reduces symmetric B, ||(I-P)B(I-P)||op<=beta<a, A=B+T with ||T||op<=delta, and Pi=1_{|A|>=a}, then ||(I-P)Pi||op<=sqrt(2)delta/(a-beta), hence sqrt(Pi_ii)<=sqrt(P_ii)+sqrt(2)delta/(a-beta). At a=1/64 this compiles with the spectral-window theorem whenever the final leverage is <=1/32.
additional_spectrum_scope: Any symmetric S=PSP may have arbitrary rank, sign, inertia, mixing, and norm; it costs nothing in the leakage bound. Literal arbitrary eigenvalue replacement inside a degenerate protected subspace is a special case.
dense_tail_rule: Dense T is used only through deterministic matrix operator norm and never treated as a uniformly small random quadratic perturbation.
e5f_application: On the Hadamard two-bank family with five protected +4 modes and ||T||op<=1/1024, the final cross block has s5>=2-1/1024, so D5 gives ||p_Q||infinity<=5sqrt(2e)/(2-1/1024)=5.83195758953... .
